text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- All political parties taking part in the national conference approve main proposals in a platform rejecting violence and political hatred. But they stand by separate demands over elections agenda.
- Former prime minister Mouloud Hamrouche rejects presidential invitation to attend the conference, saying planned reforms propose no solution for the crisis.
- The national conference will be remembered as a historic event enabling Algeria to face challenge of future.
- President Liamine Zeroual underlined in his address to the national conference that he wants to be president of all Algerians and above political divisions.

- The autorities rules out setting up a government of national union in which opposition parties will be represented. They believe this would be pointless as general elections are planned for the first quarter of 1997.
